cohort: The study included 200 antenatal women with one or more risk factors for high-risk pregnancy.
finding: The study found significant differences between reactive and non-reactive NST patterns in terms of Apgar scores and NICU admissions, suggesting that judicious use of NST can help in timely identification of at-risk fetuses.
mod_finding: Non-reactive NST patterns were associated with a higher incidence of caesarean section (81%) compared to reactive NST patterns (58.6%).
